meta.title: HaKorem Farms: fresh meat, eggs and live animals
meta.description: Fresh meat weighed to order, eggs by the crate, live animals and produce from HaKorem Farms in Ghana. Delivered to your door or collected from the farm.
meta.categoryDescription: {{category}} from HaKorem Farms, from the farm to your table.

header.tagline: From the farm to your table

home.eyebrow: From our farm to your table
home.title: Fresh meat, eggs and live animals, straight from the farm
home.body: Meat cut and packed on the farm and weighed to order, eggs by the crate, live animals chosen with you, and fresh produce. Delivered to your door or collected from the farm.

how.title: How buying by weight works
how.oneBody: Meat is priced per kg. Each pack shows its usual weight, so you see an estimate before you pay.
how.twoTitle: We weigh it before it leaves
how.twoBody: Every pack is weighed on the farm's scale on the day it is sent.
how.threeTitle: You pay for what it weighs
how.threeBody: The checkout shows the most you can be charged. If a pack weighs less, you get the difference back.

weighed.title: Priced by weight
weighed.rule: Each pack is weighed before it is sent and you pay for the weighed amount. The checkout shows the estimate and the most you can be charged.

request.title: Live animals are sold by request
request.body: We choose the animal with you and agree its price before anything is paid. Asking online opens soon; until then, visit the farm or call the shop.
request.bodyWithContact: We choose the animal with you and agree its price before anything is paid. Asking online opens soon; until then, call or WhatsApp the shop, or visit the farm.

refusals.REQUEST_TO_BUY_ONLY: Live animals are sold by request, so they cannot go in the basket.
refusals.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: This item cannot be bought online just now.
refusals.QUANTITY_INVALID: That quantity cannot be ordered. Whole packs, crates or animals only, and up to 50 lines in a basket.
refusals.CART_NOT_ACTIVE: Your basket is already at the checkout. Finish or end that checkout first.
refusals.STOCK_UNAVAILABLE: There is not enough in stock for some items. Lower the quantity or remove them from the basket.
refusals.DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: We do not deliver to that address yet. You can collect from the farm instead.
refusals.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: That delivery time cannot be booked any more. Choose another.
refusals.CHECKOUT_NOT_OPEN: The time we held your items for has ended. Hold them again.
refusals.COUPON_UNAVAILABLE: That coupon cannot be used on this basket.
refusals.COUPON_ALREADY_APPLIED: A coupon is already applied. Remove it to use another.
refusals.NOT_FOUND: We could not find your basket. Start a new one from the shop.
refusals.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
refusals.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The checkout is busy. Wait a minute and try again.
refusals.NETWORK_ERROR: The shop could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
refusals.TIMEOUT: The shop took too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.

footer.label: Site
footer.about: HaKorem Farms. Livestock, meat and fresh produce from our farm in Ghana. HaKorem means the vinedresser, the farmer.
footer.buyingByWeight: Weighed items are priced per kg and charged on their weighed weight, never more than the most shown at checkout.
